policy: Initial calibrated-gain choice; after gain profile fit collect a rolling 9-window CV history. Require 7 values >= .12 to enable, or 7 <= .09 to disable. Apply switch on next window; clear history/background/pending confirmations; preserve admitted memory; suppress three settling windows. No data-driven parameter fitting.
development_observation: Fast transitions improve and stationary returns recover recall on two development seeds; stationary-to-slow loses some localized identity while reducing false attention. Retain this version for evaluation without parameter changes.
comparison: All three existing transition methods plus adaptive; same 10 cases and paired no-target controls as transition-protocol.json
primary: After-change localized repeat identity, IoU >= .25, preserving prior occurrence/admission history
secondary: latency until five successive windows in the expected final mode
information_boundary: Expected final mode and change times are evaluator-only diagnostic definitions, never supplied to any actor
uncertainty: 10000 paired seed bootstrap draws, RNG 731; descriptive intervals
limitations: Contaminated startup and independent source overlap tracked separately
